core_rule: An intelligence family is a governed Level-6 synthesis workspace over existing principal dimensions, not a new field/entity and not a license for unreviewed cross-dimensional comparison.

families.label: Application Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate application evidence role, application taxonomy and physical-system context without collapsing them.

families.label: Problem Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate the scientific-problem landscape across physical systems, problems, governing equations, characteristics, data regimes and PINN challenges while preserving each owner.

families.label: Computational-Task Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide the family-level analytical view of computational tasks and scientific objectives without reclassifying problems or challenges as tasks.

families.label: PINN-Type Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide the family-level view of governed PINN type/family assignments using the Task 4 taxonomy and explorer safeguards.

families.label: Methodology Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate data/observation regime with the owner-preserving methodology parent without creating a generic methodology variable or pooled method frequency.

families.label: Contribution Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide the family-level view of reported contributions/innovations while preserving structured contribution records and evidence.

families.label: Outcome Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate claim-versus-demonstration, generality/transfer scope, outcome/resolution and reported advantages/disadvantages/failures without merging these semantics.

families.label: Validation Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate validation strategy and validation reference/data/baseline context while keeping validation distinct from evaluation.

families.label: Evaluation Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate metric identity with context-rich evaluation observations while prohibiting naive pooling of heterogeneous metrics/results.

families.label: Reproducibility Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate study-design/review-scope context with reproducibility availability and computational reporting without turning reporting completeness into scientific quality.

families.label: Limitations Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide evidence-grounded synthesis of reported study limitations while preserving statement, paper and independent-recurrence counts.

families.label: Open-Problem Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide evidence-grounded synthesis of explicit open problems while preventing automatic promotion to Atlas research gaps.

families.label: Future-Work Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide evidence-grounded synthesis of reported future-work directions while separating author proposals from Atlas opportunities.

families.label: Research-Gap Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide a read-only Level-6 analytical view over already governed Level-7 Atlas research-gap objects.

families.label: Research-Opportunity Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide a read-only Level-6 analytical view over already governed Level-7 Atlas research-opportunity objects.

families.label: Failure-Mode / Diagnostic Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate challenges, reported failures/disadvantages, limitations, open problems and diagnostic pathways without inferring diagnosis, causality or Level-7 framework conclusions.

families.label: Evidence Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide a corpus-level evidence and integrity meta-view across source context, study scope, claim/demonstration, generality, provenance, support/verification and contradictions without creating a scalar quality score.

families.label: Relationship Intelligence
families.purpose: Provide family-level analysis of explicit typed scientific relation instances while preserving relation semantics and graph boundaries.

families.label: Temporal Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate temporal context with publication/source context while preserving date semantics and avoiding unapproved cross-dimensional trend comparisons.

families.label: Domain / Geographic / Collaboration Intelligence
families.purpose: Coordinate application-domain taxonomy, geographic provenance, institutions and bibliographic collaboration as distinct views without turning network/geographic prominence into scientific quality.
